title: File:Talatal Ghar - part of the ruins.jpg
author: Kanad Sanyal
description: Construction of Talatal Ghar, the largest monument of the Tai Ahom kingdom, was started in 1707 by the King Rudra Singh once he shifted his capital to Rangpur from Garhgaon. Subsequent kings built upon and enlarged the structure till it reached seven stories – three underground and the balance above it. The British sealed the underground portions and what remains above is just a pale shadow of the old grand palace.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
